docs.presetsCoats.component: The stock coat recipes, each on its own page and its own knob. A coat is a RUNTIME layer over a
surface — `Atoms/Coated` teaches the atom and its reach; this shelf answers the narrower question:
what does `wash`, `ring`, `fill` or `censor` already look like, and what does its `level` do.
The recipes differ by the KIND of mark, never by value — an overlay, a stroke, a clipped fill, a
mask — so a darken and a charge are one `wash` told apart by tint and level. `clear` draws nothing
by itself, so its page shows it at work: stopping a cast cascade so a spotlight can light one
docs.presetsCoats.wash: A flat colour over the whole surface, opacity from `level`. The continuum lives here: a mana shard
charging, a figure dimming as it loses HP, a frozen tray greying — one recipe, and the magnitude is
the parameter. Drag `level`, pick a `tint`; there is no scene per value and no record per colour.
docs.presetsCoats.ring: A stroke around the contour, its weight growing with `level` — a selection ring, a ward. It is a
stroke, so it stands in for the surface's own border while it lasts: one stroke per quad.
docs.presetsCoats.fill: The blueprint completing: a SOLID coat over `level` of the face, bottom-up, cut off where the level
stops. A different KIND of mark from `wash` — a half-built thing is half DRAWN, not half faded —
and the hard cut edge is what says so. The fraction becomes clip points in the plan, where a unit
test reads them; the painter only obeys a mask.
docs.presetsCoats.clear: The recipe that draws NOTHING — its whole job is to STOP a cast. The tray casts a wash over both
tiles; the right one carries `clear`, so the nearest-cast walk stops there and the tile stays lit.
«All but this one» is a dim on the tray and a `clear` on the exception — overriding an inherited
docs.presetsCoats.censor: A mask over the surface, and a shader that animates it. The wash guarantees a visible bar with no
GPU at all; on the glass a named `blur` filter shimmers over it, built and clocked by the painter.
The atom holds the static truth — `censor`, a strength — and the animation is the render tier's.
